name: ne555dr
description: Texas Instruments NE555DR precision timer, SOIC-8, 4.5–16 V (LCSC C7593, JLCPCB basic part); behavioural SPICE model

pins.name: TRIG
pins.description: trigger: output goes high when below 1/3 VCC

pins.name: RESET
pins.description: active low; tie to VCC when unused

pins.name: THR
pins.description: threshold: output goes low when above 2/3 VCC

spice.model:
.subckt NE555_BEHAV GND TRIG OUT RESET CTRL THR DIS VCC
* internal divider: CTRL sits at 2/3 VCC, ctl3 at 1/3 VCC
Rd1 VCC CTRL 5k
Rd2 CTRL ctl3 5k
Rd3 ctl3 GND 5k
* set/reset latch: trigger sets, threshold resets, otherwise regenerate to a rail
Bst st_in GND V = (V(RESET,GND) < 0.7) ? 0 : ((V(TRIG,GND) < V(ctl3,GND)) ? V(VCC,GND) : ((V(THR,GND) > V(CTRL,GND)) ? 0 : ((V(st,GND) > V(VCC,GND)/2) ? V(VCC,GND) : 0)))
Rst st_in st 100
Cst st GND 10p
* totem-pole output: ~1.2 V below VCC when high, ~0.1 V when low
Bout out_i GND V = (V(st,GND) > V(VCC,GND)/2) ? V(VCC,GND) - 1.2 : 0.1
Vsense out_i out_j 0
Rout out_j OUT 10
* current sourced by the output is drawn from VCC
Bsup VCC GND I = max(i(Vsense), 0)
* discharge transistor conducts while the latch is low
Sdis DIS GND GND st swdis
.model swdis SW(Ron=15 Roff=1e9 Vt=-2.5 Vh=0.2)
* quiescent supply current
Rq VCC GND 20k
.ends NE555_BEHAV

metadata.rotation_note: JLCPCB's SOIC-8 zero orientation is body horizontal with pin 1 bottom-left; this footprint has pin 1 top-left (pins down the left side), which is their orientation turned 270 deg CCW
